svg.title: Each change, tested on fresh questions
svg.desc: Questions fixed minus questions broken by each round of changes, on a fresh batch of 8 to 20 questions written blind before the change. Kept: round 2 +1, 3b +5, 6a +6, 7 +2, 9 +10, 11 0, 12 +1, rounds 9 to 12 together 0. Kept in part: round 10 -1. Rejected: round 8 -1, 13 -1, 14 -3.
svg.text: Each change, tested on fresh questions
questions fixed minus questions broken, on a batch written blind before the change
